dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's always like this... So embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: Ah, well, I'm a supplier who delivers ingredients for Ms. Chanca every so often.

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: But even though all I do is help carry things around from time to time, she always insists that I stay for a meal.

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: The issue is, I have quite the appetite... So I always feel guilty eating here without paying.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your boss seems like the nice sort.

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's just how Ms. Chanca is.

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: Did you know that she used to be a top-ranking warrior in the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame?

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: But she was forced to retire after seriously injuring her leg in the Night Warden Wars.

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: Many people used to come here on her reputation's account, but she never liked them making all that fuss.

dialogues.speaker: Tizoc
dialogues.text: On that note, I suppose I shouldn't say too much either. All I'll say is, she's a very reliable owner, and this is a great place to come to.
